faq.question: Can I enroll in Graphic Design Professional as a complete beginner?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum begins with foundational design principles, visual communication, and thumbnail sketching in Module 01 before introducing software. Zero prior graphic design experience or art school background is required.

faq.question: What is the duration and weekly time commitment of this program?
faq.answer: The program runs for 4 Months (16 calendar weeks) and includes exactly 160 guided instructional hours (~10 hours per week of mentored instruction) plus 40–60 hours of recommended independent studio lab practice.

faq.question: How does Graphic Design Professional differ from the 8-month Creative Design Master?
faq.answer: Graphic Design Professional is a focused 4-month program specializing in commercial 2D graphic design, branding, advertising, social media creatives, print production, and generative AI. Creative Design Master is an 8-month multidisciplinary diploma that also covers responsive UI/UX design in Figma, motion graphics in After Effects, and 3D product animation.

faq.question: What is covered in the Adobe Photoshop curriculum?
faq.answer: Photoshop training covers non-destructive workflows, adjustment layers, Smart Objects, Pen Tool selection masking, Frequency Separation skin retouching, product compositing, lighting harmonization, Generative Fill, Generative Expand, and high-resolution export optimization.

faq.question: What is covered in the Adobe Illustrator curriculum?
faq.answer: Illustrator training focuses on professional vector design: Bézier curve mastery, extrema anchor placement, Shape Builder and Pathfinder operations, typographic hierarchy, responsive logo lockups, iconography, patterns, packaging dielines, and Text-to-Vector AI generation.

faq.question: Why are CorelDRAW and Adobe InDesign included in this course?
faq.answer: InDesign is the global publishing benchmark for multi-page documents (brochures, catalogs, lookbooks). CorelDRAW is taught as a prepress export bridge specifically addressing the realities of the Indian commercial printing press ecosystem, ensuring your files print accurately at regional print shops.

faq.question: Why is Canva Pro taught alongside professional Adobe software?
faq.answer: Over 65% of marketing agencies, startups, and clients require Canva templates for fast daily social posting. Learning to build locked Brand Kits and client-proof templates in Canva Pro enables graduates to deliver high-value, self-serve design solutions to freelance clients.

faq.question: How is Adobe Firefly and Generative AI integrated into the course?
faq.answer: Generative AI is taught in Module 07 as a professional productivity accelerator. You learn structured prompt engineering, Generative Fill/Expand in Photoshop, Text-to-Vector in Illustrator, and hybrid art direction pipelines, while strictly adhering to commercial safety and C2PA Content Credentials provenance.

faq.question: What are the rules regarding Generative Fill, Expand, and AI vector generation?
faq.answer: AI generation is treated as an ideation and scaffolding tool, never as a finished design. Raw AI imagery is never accepted without manual human intervention: typography, vector geometry, lighting refinement, and C2PA disclosure must be executed by the student.

faq.question: Are software licenses included in the course tuition fee?
faq.answer: No. Students procure their own Adobe Creative Cloud subscriptions. Adobe India offers discounted student plans for approximately ₹1,500/month. Free trials and student access instructions are provided during onboarding.

faq.question: Are expensive AI subscriptions required?
faq.answer: No. Adobe Firefly includes free monthly generative credits with Creative Cloud plans. Midjourney demonstration labs are provided, but zero paid Midjourney subscriptions are mandatory. Free tools like ChatGPT and Google Gemini are fully sufficient for all coursework.

faq.question: How many portfolio projects will I build during the program?
faq.answer: You build exactly 4 major assessable portfolio case studies: (1) Professional Logo & Brand Identity Starter Kit, (2) Premium Product Advertising Key Visual, (3) Multi-Format Social Media Advertising Campaign, and (4) Integrated Print-to-Digital Client Capstone.

faq.question: What practical assignments and studio labs are included?
faq.answer: Each of the 8 modules concludes with a graded classroom studio lab and practical assignment modeled on real-world agency briefs, totaling 8 assessed studio labs alongside the 4 major case studies.

faq.question: What commercial print production skills are taught?
faq.answer: You learn prepress preflight inspection, 3mm bleeds, crop marks, Total Area Coverage (TAC <= 300%), rich black formulas, Pantone spot colors, packaging folding dielines, spot UV/foil separation plates, and certified ISO PDF/X-4 export standards.

faq.question: What career pathways does this program prepare me for?
faq.answer: Graduates are qualified for roles including Junior Graphic Designer, Graphic Designer, Social Media Designer, Advertising Creative Designer, Junior Brand Identity Designer, Print Production Designer, Visual Content Designer, and Freelance Graphic Designer. It does not promise immediate senior or creative director roles.

Precision extraction using the Pen Tool for hard edges, Select & Mask workspace, and Channel calculations for fine flyaway hair and semi-translucent smoke.
subtopics: The non-destructive editing paradigm: why destructive erasing and direct image adjustments are banned in agency workflows
Smart Objects: embedding, linking, transforming, and applying non-destructive Smart Filters
Pen Tool vector clipping paths: creating razor-sharp selections on manufactured consumer products
Select and Mask workspace: Refine Edge brush, Global Refinements (Radius, Smooth, Feather, Contrast, Shift Edge)
Channel-based masking: duplicating high-contrast RGB channels and applying Levels/Curves to extract flyaway hair
Color de-contamination: eliminating background color fringing and ambient spill on extracted subjects
lessons.why_it_matters: Jagged, haloed, or poorly extracted product cutouts instantly destroy commercial advertising credibility. Pen tool clipping and channel extraction are mandatory technical competencies tested during design agency hiring interviews.
lessons.what_learner_does: Isolate a manufactured smartphone product using the Pen tool with razor-sharp edges; isolate a human model with complex curly hair against a busy background using Channel masking; composite both onto clean studio podiums.
lessons.expected_outcome: Two flawlessly extracted subjects saved with non-destructive layer masks, zero fringing, and complete edge detail preservation.
lessons.example: Extracting an athlete with flyaway hair against an outdoor stadium background, eliminating green turf color cast using a clipped Hue/Saturation adjustment layer set to Color blend mode.

lessons.lesson_title: Commercial Retouching, Frequency Separation & Product Cleanup
lessons.what_is_taught: Commercial photo retouching toolchain: Spot Healing Brush, Healing Brush, Clone Stamp, Content-Aware Fill. Mathematical 16-bit Frequency Separation (Apply Image calculations) to split images into high-frequency texture and low-frequency tone/color. Non-destructive skin smoothing and 50% neutral gray dodge/burn contouring.
subtopics: Healing toolchain mechanics: sample all layers, aligned vs non-aligned sampling, diffusion settings
Mathematical Frequency Separation setup: 16-bit Subtract/Add formulas vs 8-bit Apply Image calculations
Texture repair on the high-frequency layer: eliminating blemishes, stray hairs, and dust while preserving raw skin pores
Tone and color blending on the low-frequency layer: smoothing blotchy redness and foundation tones with the Mixer Brush
Dodge and Burn: creating non-destructive 50% gray overlay layers to enhance cheekbones, eye highlights, and product contours
E-commerce product cleanup: removing manufacturing seams, micro-scratches, and lint from luxury glass and metal surfaces
lessons.why_it_matters: Over-blurred, plastic-looking skin from amateur blur filters is rejected by commercial clients. Professional retouching demands frequency separation to smooth skin tone while keeping 100% of natural pore texture intact.
lessons.what_learner_does: Retouch a raw high-resolution beauty portrait using 16-bit Frequency Separation; clean dust and scratches off a luxury perfume bottle photo; hand-craft photorealistic contact, ambient, and directional drop shadows.
lessons.expected_outcome: A polished commercial beauty portrait with authentic skin texture and an Amazon/Flipkart-ready luxury product packshot on a pure white background.
lessons.example: Removing a severe facial blemish by cloning texture on the High Frequency layer while leaving the underlying cheekbone shadow contour on the Low Frequency layer completely untouched.

lessons.lesson_title: Photographic Compositing, Perspective Matching & Lighting Harmonization
lessons.what_is_taught: Multi-source photographic compositing: blending disparate background, subject, and foreground photographic assets into a unified visual. Matching horizon lines, vanishing points, perspective grids, light source angles, ambient bounce light, and color temperature harmonization.
subtopics: Analyzing photographic perspective: identifying horizon lines, camera focal length, and vanishing points
Lighting analysis: matching key light, fill light, rim light, and ambient environment bounce
Hand-crafting 3-tier realistic shadows: dense contact shadow, soft ambient occlusion, and directional cast shadow
Color temperature harmonization: using Curves adjustment layers clipped to subjects to match ambient color balance
Selective Color and Gradient Map color grading for a unified cinematic commercial look
Atmospheric depth: adding Gaussian depth-of-field blurs, atmospheric fog/haze, dust motes, and lens flare integration
lessons.why_it_matters: Commercial advertising campaigns frequently combine stock assets shot under different studio lighting conditions. Master compositors harmonize perspective and color so disparate elements look shot in a single camera take.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a dramatic outdoor adventure commercial visual combining a mountain landscape background, athlete subject cutout, dramatic sky replacement, and product packshot; balance lighting and color grade the complete composite.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully layered master advertising composite PSD with all adjustment layers, shadow layers, and atmospheric depth intact.
lessons.example: Using a Curves adjustment layer clipped to an athlete subject, pulling up cyan in the shadows and adding warm yellow/red in the highlights to match a sunset mountain background.

lessons.lesson_title: Photoshop Generative AI Workflows, Inpainting & Commercial Production Export
lessons.what_is_taught: Photoshop native generative AI features: Generative Fill, Generative Expand, Generate Background, Harmonize. Reference image workflows, non-destructive layer management of AI assets, artifact removal, High Pass sharpening, and multi-format commercial export.
subtopics: Generative Fill mechanics: prompt syntax, selection boundary feathering, and generative variation selection
Generative Expand: adapting tight vertical portrait product photography into wide 16:9 marketing headers
Generate Background: contextual backdrop replacement for e-commerce studio product cutouts
Harmonize: automated tone and lighting blending between extracted subjects and new backgrounds
Manual cleanup of AI artifacts: fixing distorted textures, unnatural edges, and synthetic blur with manual clone/stamp
Commercial export optimization: WebP for e-commerce web speed, progressive JPEG, 24-bit PNG with transparency
High Pass filter sharpening and unsharp masking tailored for high-DPI retina screens vs commercial print
lessons.why_it_matters: Generative AI handles routine image expansion and background replacement in minutes rather than hours. However, professional designers must manually audit, clean, and color-harmonize AI outputs to ensure commercial print and web readiness.
lessons.what_learner_does: Take a tight vertical product photo, expand the canvas horizontally to 16:9 using Generative Expand, eliminate unwanted objects via Generative Fill, manually clean AI artifacts, apply High Pass sharpening, and export WebP/JPEG formats.
lessons.expected_outcome: A wide-format commercial banner with seamless background extensions, zero AI artifacts, and optimized web exports.
lessons.example: Expanding a luxury watch studio photo into a wide 16:9 banner placed on rugged granite rock, manually repainting the watch contact shadow to ensure physical realism.

modules.expected_outcome: Master layered PSD archive exhibiting flawless layer masks, organized color-coded groups, non-destructive Smart Filters, frequency separation layers intact, realistic shadow and lighting integration, and web-ready exports.

Conducting client discovery interviews, competitor visual positioning matrices, and executing the 50-thumbnail sketching challenge.
subtopics: Brand identity fundamentals: core mission, values, target demographic, and emotional positioning
The 12 brand archetypes and their visual representation in typography, color, and symbolism
Competitor visual auditing: constructing 4-quadrant positioning matrices to identify market white space
Authoring the Client Discovery Questionnaire and translating responses into a Strategic Brand Brief
Divergent concept generation: mind mapping visual metaphors, word association, and eliminating initial clichés
The 50-thumbnail sketching sprint: rigorous analog pencil exploration exploring multiple visual directions
Using ChatGPT for brand archetype ideation, competitor analysis synthesis, and visual metaphor brainstorming
lessons.why_it_matters: Great commercial logos are engineered on paper through rigorous conceptual exploration, not by randomly manipulating shapes in Illustrator. Designers who skip analog sketching produce cliché, superficial marks that fail to differentiate the client's business.
lessons.what_learner_does: Review an assigned client brief for an urban electric mobility startup or artisanal specialty food brand; author a 2-page Strategic Brand Brief; sketch 40 divergent logo concepts on paper across wordmark, symbol, and emblem styles.
lessons.expected_outcome: A completed Strategic Brand Brief document and two pages of divergent analog thumbnail sketches.
lessons.example: Brainstorming concepts for an urban mobility brand that combine kinetic forward motion with the letter 'M' without resorting to generic arrows or car silhouettes.

lessons.lesson_title: Vector Logo Engineering, Geometric Construction Grids & Monochrome Testing
lessons.what_is_taught: Translating paper thumbnail sketches into precise vector geometry in Adobe Illustrator. Constructing circular guides, Golden Ratio proportions, tangent line alignment, Shape Builder unification, optical kerning of custom wordmarks, and monochrome black-and-white testing.
subtopics: Importing sketches into Illustrator, setting up template layers, guides, and construction grids
Circular grid construction: Golden Ratio circles, tangent curves, and mathematical concentric arcs
Shape Builder and Pathfinder execution: merging positive vector shapes and carving negative space
Optical corrections in logo design: compensating for geometric illusions, overshoot, and stroke weight balance
Customizing wordmarks: adjusting letterform terminals, kerning pairs, and ligature modifications
The Monochrome Rule: testing all logo marks in 100% solid black and solid white to verify silhouette strength before adding color
Trademark originality checks: performing reverse image searching and similarity auditing on draft concepts
lessons.why_it_matters: A logo mark that relies on color or gradients to communicate fails on faxes, black-and-white receipts, embroidery, or metal engraving. Geometric construction ensures mathematical balance and visual impact at any scale.
lessons.what_learner_does: Vectorize a selected logo sketch on a geometric circular grid in Illustrator; verify anchor point minimization; test the mark in 100% solid black and white; and execute trademark originality checks.
lessons.expected_outcome: A master vector logo mark engineered on a geometric grid, verified in solid monochrome at both 24px and 1000px scales.
lessons.example: Aligning the curvature of a modern tech lettermark to intersecting concentric circles, ensuring smooth visual momentum with zero awkward kinks.

lessons.lesson_title: Responsive Logo Suite, Corporate Stationery & Smart Object Mockups
lessons.what_is_taught: Building a modern responsive logo family: primary horizontal lockup, secondary stacked/vertical mark, standalone monogram symbol, and 16px micro-favicon. Designing corporate stationery (business cards with spot finishes, letterhead, envelopes) and photorealistic Photoshop mockups.

Deriving the complete logo family: horizontal lockup, stacked mark, standalone icon, and 16px favicon
Standard commercial stationery dimensions: business cards (85x55mm / 3.5x2 in), letterhead (A4 / US Letter), envelopes
Prepress setup for stationery: 3mm bleeds, safe inner margins, and configuring dedicated Spot UV separation plates
Photorealistic mockup engineering: placing stationery designs into high-resolution Photoshop Smart Object mockups
Exporting certified print PDFs for stationery offset printing

lessons.what_learner_does: Build a 4-tier responsive logo suite; design a double-sided corporate business card with Spot UV finish and letterhead; render the collateral in high-resolution photorealistic Photoshop mockups.
lessons.expected_outcome: An artboard containing the complete responsive logo family, print-ready stationery source files, and 3D mockup renders.

lessons.lesson_title: Brand Style Guide Authoring, Client Handover & Trademark Risk Review

subtopics: The purpose and structure of an agency Brand Style Guide manual
Documenting clear space exclusion zones mathematically using logo element heights (e.g. 0.5X)
Establishing minimum reproduction sizes for digital screens (pixels) and physical print (millimeters)
Certified color governance: documenting exact Pantone Solid Coated swatches alongside CMYK, RGB, and HEX formulas
Documenting brand typographic hierarchy: primary headline font, secondary body font, system fallbacks
Logo misuse rules: illustrating unacceptable modifications (distortion, drop shadows, unauthorized colors)
Standardized client delivery packaging: folder hierarchies, file naming conventions, and vector/raster export packages
lessons.why_it_matters: A logo is practically useless to a client without governance guidelines; improper spacing, unauthorized stretching, and mismatched colors instantly destroy brand integrity. Standardized client handover packages prevent technical support headaches.
lessons.what_learner_does: Author and typeset a 12-page interactive Brand Style Guide PDF; assemble a client handover archive folder containing organized AI, EPS, SVG, and PNG assets.
lessons.expected_outcome: A professional 12-page Brand Style Guide PDF and a standardized client handover package.
lessons.example: Formulating the clear space formula as 0.5X, where X equals the exact height of the logo mark icon, ensuring no text or graphics encroach on the logo.

lessons.lesson_title: Performance Ad Anatomy, Aspect Ratios & Mobile Safe Zones
lessons.what_is_taught: The visual consumption mechanics of mobile feeds: the 1.5-second attention span rule. The anatomy of high-converting performance ads: Visual Hook, Value Proposition headline, supporting benefit copy, and Call-to-Action (CTA) button. Platform aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) and vertical safe zones.
subtopics: Analyzing user eye-tracking on mobile feeds: visual entry points and scanning behavior
The 4-part anatomy of high-converting performance ads: Hook, Value Prop, Benefit, CTA
Platform dimension specifications: Instagram feed (1:1, 4:5), Stories/Reels (9:16), Facebook, LinkedIn
Vertical 9:16 safe zones: preventing interface overlap from usernames, captions, and profile icons
Button design psychology: contrast, drop shadows, hover state styling, and urgency badges ('Limited Offer')
Typographic legibility on mobile: minimum font sizes for handheld viewing
lessons.why_it_matters: Ads that ignore platform safe zones have vital pricing, headlines, or CTA buttons obscured by app interface overlays, causing immediate drop-offs in click-through rates and wasted client advertising spend.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a high-impact commercial promotion for a D2C consumer brand across 1:1 square feed, 4:5 vertical feed, and 9:16 Story formats, rigorously testing alignment against mobile UI safe zone overlays.
lessons.expected_outcome: Three platform-compliant advertising creatives with sharp product isolation, prominent CTA buttons, and zero safe-zone overlap.
lessons.example: Restricting primary headline and CTA button placement strictly to the central 1080x1420px safe zone of a 1080x1920px Instagram Story canvas.

lessons.lesson_title: Multi-Slide Panoramic Carousels in Photoshop & Illustrator
lessons.what_is_taught: The mechanics of multi-slide panoramic carousels: setting up continuous wide artboards, dividing canvas slices with the Slice Tool, creating graphic elements and photography that seamlessly bleed across slide boundaries, and compelling swipe hooks.
subtopics: Why carousels generate 3x higher engagement than single static posts on Instagram and LinkedIn
Setting up continuous panoramic canvases: 5400x1080px (5 slides) in Photoshop and Illustrator
The Slice Tool: configuring pixel-perfect slice guides for seamless individual export
Graphic crossover mechanics: bleeding product photography, abstract vector shapes, and connecting lines across slides
Slide-by-slide narrative structure: Slide 1 (Hook), Slides 2-4 (Value/Proof), Slide 5 (CTA/Save/Share)
Educational and comparison carousel formatting: managing dense typography with visual cards and badges
lessons.why_it_matters: Carousels compel prospective buyers to swipe through an educational or product journey. Seamless visual crossovers visually link slides together, significantly reducing bounce rates.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a 5-slide seamless panoramic carousel for an educational product guide or e-commerce lookbook, slice the canvas, and export individual 1080x1080px frames.
lessons.expected_outcome: A 5-slide seamless panoramic carousel kit with flowing graphic transitions, strong narrative pacing, and final conversion CTA.
lessons.example: Positioning a product image so that 65% appears on Slide 2 and 35% bleeds onto Slide 3, creating an irresistible visual incentive for the viewer to swipe.

lessons.lesson_title: High-CTR YouTube Thumbnails & Multi-Size Display Banners

Photoshop layer styles for thumbnails: outer glow, high-contrast stroke outlines, and directional drop shadows
Standard IAB digital display banner dimensions: Medium Rectangle (300x250), Leaderboard (728x90), Wide Skyscraper (160x600)
Adapting a single master key visual across horizontal, vertical, and square banner ratios
File size optimization: compressing display ads under 150KB for ad server compliance
lessons.why_it_matters: In competitive video and digital advertising platforms, the thumbnail or display banner determines 90% of user clicks. Cluttered, unreadable thumbnails fail to convert viewers into paying traffic.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design 2 high-CTR YouTube thumbnails for an EdTech/Tech channel, test readability at tiny scale, and adapt the visual into 3 standard Google Display Network banners (300x250, 728x90, 160x600).
lessons.expected_outcome: Two high-impact YouTube thumbnails and three coordinated display advertising banners formatted for ad network deployment.
lessons.example: Applying an outer glow and contrasting yellow stroke to an isolated human subject against a dark background, pairing it with a 3-word bold headline in Montserrat Black.

lessons.lesson_title: Adobe InDesign Publication Layout, Master Spreads & Style Sheets
lessons.what_is_taught: Adobe InDesign interface and multi-page editorial layout: parent master pages, automatic page numbering, margin and column grids, paragraph and character style sheets, nested styles, baseline grid snapping, and links panel management.
subtopics: InDesign desktop publishing workspace: pages panel, spreads, facing pages, and primary text frames
Parent master pages: creating running headers, footers, section markers, and dynamic auto-page numbering
Typographic style sheets: Paragraph Styles, Character Styles, nested styles, and global typographic updates
Baseline grid alignment: snapping body text across multiple columns for consistent horizontal rhythm
Links panel management: understanding linked vs embedded assets, missing links, and modified link alerts
Effective resolution vs actual resolution: enforcing the mandatory 300 DPI effective PPI print standard
lessons.why_it_matters: Designing multi-page brochures, company profiles, or catalogs in Photoshop or Illustrator is highly inefficient and unmaintainable. InDesign is the universal global standard for editorial layout, typography consistency, and prepress reliability.
lessons.what_learner_does: Layout an 8-page corporate company profile or product brochure with parent master page headers, 3-column grids, paragraph styles, and linked 300 DPI photography.
lessons.expected_outcome: A structured, professionally formatted 8-page InDesign publication file with zero missing links and zero overset text.
lessons.example: Applying a Paragraph Style across 24 headlines simultaneously so that updating font choice or tracking applies across all 8 pages in a single click.

lessons.lesson_title: Prepress Mechanics, Bleeds, Preflight Inspection & Certified PDF/X Export
lessons.what_is_taught: Commercial prepress mechanics: offset and digital printing processes, four-color CMYK plates, 3mm bleeds, trim marks, safe margins, rich black ($C:60, M:40, Y:40, K:100$) vs 100% K body text, overprint vs knockout, Live Preflight inspection, and certified ISO PDF/X-4 export.
subtopics: The physical offset lithography printing process: plates, blankets, ink dampening, dot gain, and paper registration
Configuring technical print margins: 3mm external bleeds, crop/trim marks, registration targets, and safe inner margins
Color management in prepress: converting RGB images to FOGRA39 or GRACoL CMYK profiles
Rich black formulas: why large black background areas require $C:60, M:40, Y:40, K:100$ to prevent washed-out dark gray prints
Overprint vs knockout: setting up overprint black to eliminate unsightly white registration gaps around fine text
InDesign Live Preflight panel: detecting overset text, RGB assets, low-resolution images, and missing font links
Certified PDF/X standards: exporting ISO PDF/X-4 and packaging InDesign archives (`File > Package`)
lessons.why_it_matters: Sending a print file without bleeds, in RGB color space, or with low-resolution images results in tens of thousands of rupees in ruined print runs. Professional prepress verification guarantees flawless physical production.
lessons.what_learner_does: Run InDesign Live Preflight on a flawed publication file, resolve all flagged preflight errors (convert RGB, fix overset text, relink missing font), configure 3mm bleeds, and export certified print-ready PDF/X-4.
lessons.expected_outcome: A certified, error-free print-ready PDF with crop marks, registration marks, and 3mm bleeds, plus a packaged archive folder.
lessons.example: Detecting a product image whose actual PPI is 300 but whose effective PPI dropped to 142 because it was enlarged to 215% on the page, and replacing it with an uncropped high-resolution asset.

lessons.lesson_title: Packaging Dieline Artwork, Spot Finishes & 3D Packshots

subtopics: Anatomy of packaging dielines: solid line for cut, dashed line for crease/fold, cross-hatched for glue tabs
Working within structural dieline constraints: orientation of top flaps, side panels, and bottom tuck closures
Technical spot finish separation: creating dedicated non-printing layers for Spot UV varnish and Gold Foil stamping
Configuring spot color swatches: creating 100% Magenta Spot Colors named `Spot_UV` set to Overprint in Attributes

lessons.what_learner_does: Prepare an event promotional flyer and flex banner, convert all typography to outlines, export verified PDF/X-1a and legacy EPS files tested for CorelDRAW import, and author a Vendor Print Specification Sheet.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complete print vendor handover bundle containing PDF/X, EPS, and a Print Production Specification Sheet.

The 8-part structured visual prompt formula: Subject, Medium, Art Style, Lighting, Color Palette, Composition, Camera Angle, Atmosphere. Using ChatGPT to brainstorm visual metaphors. Firefly Boards for rapid concept curation and multi-variant stylescapes.
subtopics: Capabilities and limitations of generative diffusion models in professional graphic design workflows
The 8-part prompt architecture: eliminating prompt fluff and using professional art direction terminology
Subject description, material texture, lighting (chiaroscuro, rim, diffused), and camera optics (35mm, macro, low-angle)
Adobe Firefly interface: Firefly Boards, setting aspect ratios, Style Reference, and Composition Reference
Using ChatGPT and Gemini for prompt expansion, visual metaphor brainstorming, and moodboard curation

lessons.lesson_title: Photoshop Generative Fill, Expand, Harmonize & Artifact Cleanup
lessons.what_is_taught: Photoshop in-app generative features: Generative Fill, Generative Expand, Generate Background, Harmonize. Reference image control, mask-driven refinement, manual perspective and lighting correction, repairing synthetic AI artifacts, and non-destructive layer hygiene.
subtopics: Photoshop Generative Fill mechanics: selection feathering, prompt specificity, and generating contextual elements
Generative Expand: adapting tight vertical product photography into wide 16:9 marketing headers seamlessly
Generate Background: replacing studio product backdrops with realistic environmental lifestyle settings
Harmonize: automated tone, shadow, and color blending between extracted foreground subjects and AI backgrounds
Manual cleanup of AI artifacts: fixing distorted textures, unnatural edges, and synthetic blur with manual clone/stamp
Non-destructive layer hygiene: managing generative layers as Smart Objects with manual masking refinement
lessons.why_it_matters: Raw AI generations frequently contain visual artifacts, distorted textures, and mismatched lighting. Graphic designers must apply manual compositing, retouching, and masking to elevate generative outputs into agency-grade client deliverables.
lessons.what_learner_does: Take a studio product photo, expand the canvas horizontally to 16:9 using Generative Expand, replace the background with an AI environmental setting, apply Harmonize, and manually retouch artifacts with Clone Stamp and Curves.
lessons.expected_outcome: A wide-format commercial advertising banner with seamless background extensions, realistic shadows, and zero visible AI artifacts.
lessons.example: Expanding a portrait beauty photo into a wide 16:9 banner placed in a sunlit botanical garden, manually repainting the subject's contact shadow to match the sunlight angle.

lessons.lesson_title: Illustrator Text-to-Vector, Generative Recolor & Vector Path QA
lessons.what_is_taught: Adobe Illustrator generative vector toolchain: Text to Vector Graphic panel (subjects, scenes, icons), Concept to Vector, Text to Pattern, Generative Recolor. Manual vector cleanup: path auditing, anchor point reduction, welding open paths, and production vector QA.
subtopics: Adobe Firefly Text to Vector Graphic: generating scalable vector subjects, scenes, and icons from text prompts
Concept to Vector: converting rough sketches and raster ideations into editable vector paths
Generative Recolor: instantaneous re-theming of complete vector illustrations using natural language color prompts
Text to Pattern: synthesizing seamless vector repeating patterns for packaging and branding applications
Auditing AI vector geometry: identifying redundant anchor points, overlapping stray paths, and open endpoints
Manual vector cleanup: running Path Simplify, manually welding anchors, and expanding strokes for production compliance
lessons.why_it_matters: AI-generated vectors typically contain hundreds of redundant anchor points and messy overlapping paths that fail technical vinyl cutting, screen printing, or embroidery tests. Manual path auditing ensures technical vector excellence.
lessons.what_learner_does: Generate a set of vector botanical motifs using Text to Vector Graphic, audit and reduce anchor points by 60%, synthesize a seamless repeating pattern tile, and generate 3 seasonal color variations using Generative Recolor.
lessons.expected_outcome: Three production-cleaned vector pattern variations with clean closed paths, unified global swatches, and optimized anchor counts.
lessons.example: Taking a raw AI-generated vector floral motif containing 420 messy points, running Path Simplify and manual anchor welding to reduce it to 54 clean, production-ready extrema points.

lessons.lesson_title: Hybrid Art Direction Pipeline, C2PA Provenance & Copyright Compliance

lessons.expected_outcome: A finished commercial advertising visual accompanied by an AI Provenance and Commercial Licensing Disclosure Sheet.
